usage: The word '斤' is used to measure weight, commonly in Hong Kong and other Cantonese-speaking regions.
'斤' typically represents a weight of approximately 600 grams.
It is used after a number to specify the amount of an item, e.g., '一斤' means one catty.
When measuring fruits, vegetables, or meat, using '斤' is very common in daily conversations.
'斤' can function as both a standalone noun and part of a compound phrase indicating quantity.
